verdict.rationale: RudderStack's compliance page says customers can store data on their own infrastructure and process it in the US, the EU, or both (rudderstack-docs-65). The self-hostable open-source edition, which depends only on PostgreSQL and has its own data plane and control plane, also supports choosing where data lives (rudderstack-docs-20, rudderstack-docs-58). missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how to select or configure a region per workspace, the full list of available regions beyond US/EU, and independent or hands-on corroboration of residency guarantees.
